# Prototype Specification: B2B SaaS Billing Admin Console

## Template & Design System
- **Template**: Custom admin console — dense, functional, data-heavy layout optimized for finance/support workflows
- **Design System**: Billing Admin DS — functional, high-density, low-whitespace, monochrome with accent colors for statuses
- **CSS Class System**:
  - Layout: `.app`, `.app-header`, `.app-nav`, `.app-main`, `.app-sidebar`, `.app-content`, `.app-footer`
  - Grid: `.grid-1`, `.grid-2`, `.grid-3`, `.grid-4`, `.grid-6`, `.grid-auto`, `.col-span-*`
  - Cards: `.card`, `.card-flat`, `.card-raised`, `.card-panel`, `.card-status-*` (success, warning, danger, info)
  - Tables: `.table`, `.table-wrap`, `.table-striped`, `.table-hover`, `.table-compact`, `.th`, `.td`, `.tr`
  - Forms: `.form`, `.form-group`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.form-checkbox`, `.form-actions`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-outline`, `.btn-sm`, `.btn-xs`
  - Status: `.badge`, `.badge-sm`, `.badge-circle`, `.status-dot`, `.status-text-*` (active, suspended, canceled)
  - Navigation: `.nav`, `.nav-item`, `.nav-link`, `.nav-link-active`, `.nav-icon`
  - Utility: `.p-*`, `.m-*`, `.text-*`, `.font-mono`, `.hidden`, `.flex`, `.flex-col`, `.justify-between`, `.items-center`, `.gap-*`, `.w-*`, `.h-*`, `.overflow-auto`
- **Color Tokens**:
  - `--bg: #0d1117` (near-black)
  - `--surface: #161b26` (dark card)
  - `--surface-elevated: #212631` (popped card)
  - `--fg: #e6edf3` (light text)
  - `--fg-muted: #8b949e` (muted text)
  - `--fg-secondary: #adbac7` (secondary text)
  - `--accent: #58a6ff` (blue accent)
  - `--accent-success: #3fb950` (green)
  - `--accent-warning: #d29922` (amber)
  - `--accent-danger: #f85149` (red)
  - `--accent-info: #79c0ff` (sky)
  - `--border: #30363d` (border)
  - `--border-active: #58a6ff`
  - `--muted: #212631` (subtle surface)

## Overview
- **Product**: Internal admin console for a B2B SaaS billing platform
- **Target audience**: Internal finance and customer support staff
- **Core purpose**: Enable ops team to review customer subscriptions, inspect invoice history, manage plan changes, and handle failed-payment recovery
- **Total pages**: 6 (Dashboard, Customers, Subscriptions, Invoices, Failed Payments, Plan Changes)

## Pages & Navigation
| Page ID | Route | Purpose | Layout Pattern | Entry Point |
|---------|-------|---------|----------------|-------------|
| dashboard | `#/dashboard` | High-level billing metrics and quick actions | hero-center + stat row + grid-3 | Yes |
| customers | `#/customers` | Searchable list of all customers with status | table + filter bar | Yes |
| subscriptions | `#/subscriptions` | List of all active/subscription-level changes | table + filter bar + quick actions |
| invoices | `#/invoices` | Invoice history with filtering and export | table + filter bar + pagination |
| failed-payments | `#/failed-payments` | List of failed payment attempts with recovery actions | table + actions column |
| plan-changes | `#/plan-changes` | Audit log of plan changes and pending requests | table + filter bar + actions |

## Page Specifications

### Dashboard (`#/dashboard`)
**Layout**: hero-center + stat row + grid-3
**Template classes**: `.app .app-header .app-nav .app-main .app-sidebar .app-content`, `.container`, `.section`, `.grid-3`, `.card`, `.card-flat`, `.card-panel`
**Components**:
- **Header**: `.app-header` with `.nav .nav-item .nav-link` (Dashboard active)
- **Sidebar**: `.app-sidebar` with `.nav .nav-item .nav-link` for Customers, Subscriptions, Invoices, Failed Payments, Plan Changes
- **Stats Row**: 4 cards showing total customers, active subscriptions, invoices this month, failed payments today (`.card .grid-4 .card-panel`)
- **Top Customers**: `.table-wrap .table-compact` with 5 rows of top spenders (customer name, MRR, invoice count, last payment date)
- **Recent Activity**: `.card .card-flat` with vertical list of recent events (plan changes, invoice generation, payment failures) with timestamp and action link
- **Quick Actions**: `.card .card-raised .grid-2` with buttons: "Review Failed Payments", "Pending Plan Changes", "Export Invoice CSV"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Review Failed Payments" → navigates to `#/failed-payments`
- Click "Pending Plan Changes" → navigates to `#/plan-changes?status=pending`
- Click customer row in "Top Customers" → navigates to `#/customers/{id}`

---

### Customers (`#/customers`)
**Layout**: table + filter bar
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section .table-wrap`, `.form`, `.form-group`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.table`, `.table-striped`, `.tr`, `.th`, `.td`
**Components**:
- **Filter Bar**: `.form .form-row` with inputs: search (text), status (select: all, active, suspended, canceled), plan (select: all, pro, team, enterprise, custom), sort (select: MRR high-low, name A-Z)
- **Customer Table**: `.table-wrap .table .table-striped` with 10 rows, columns: ID, Company Name, Status, Plan, MRR, Next Billing Date, Invoices, Contact Email, Actions (view, suspend, edit)
  - Sample row: `1012 | Acme Corp | Active | Enterprise | $4,250.00 | 2024-06-15 | 12 | finance@acme.com | [View] [Suspend] [Edit]`
  - Status badges: `.badge .badge-sm .badge-circle .status-text-*`
  - Actions column: `.btn .btn-xs .btn-primary` (View), `.btn .btn-xs .btn-danger` (Suspend)
- **Pagination**: `.form .form-row` with page selector and items per page (10, 25, 50)
**Interactions**:
- Click "View" → navigates to `#/customers/{id}`
- Click "Suspend" → sets status to suspended and refreshes table
- Click "Edit" → navigates to `#/customers/{id}/edit`
- Filter change → updates table via client-side filter

---

### Customer Detail (`#/customers/{id}`)
**Layout**: profile header + grid-2 + tabs
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section`, `.card`, `.card-flat`, `.grid-2`, `.flex`, `.flex-col`, `.gap-*`
**Components**:
- **Header Card**: `.card .card-raised` with customer name, logo, status badge, plan, MRR, next billing date, contact email/phone
- **Tabs**: `.card .card-flat` with tab navigation: Overview, Subscriptions, Invoices, Plan Changes, Notes
- **Overview Tab**: `.grid-2` with:
  - Left column: Customer details (ID, domain, signup date, support contact), Recent invoices (table, 5 rows), Recent activity (list)
  - Right column: Subscription summary (current plan, add-ons, usage limits), Failed payments history (table, 3 rows), Quick actions (Suspend, Edit Plan, Export Invoices)
- **Subscriptions Tab**: Subscription history table (columns: Plan, Start Date, End Date, MRR, Status, Actions)
- **Invoices Tab**: Invoice list (columns: Invoice #, Date, Amount, Status, PDF, Actions)
- **Plan Changes Tab**: Audit log of plan change requests and changes (columns: Date, User, Change, Status, Notes)
- **Notes Tab**: Editable note area with timestamped entries
**Interactions**:
- Click "Edit Plan" → navigates to `#/customers/{id}/edit-plan`
- Click "Suspend" → sets status to suspended and refreshes
- Click invoice PDF → opens invoice detail page
- Click plan change row → navigates to plan change detail

---

### Subscriptions (`#/subscriptions`)
**Layout**: table + filter bar + quick actions
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section .table-wrap`, `.form`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.table`, `.table-compact`, `.tr`, `.th`, `.td`
**Components**:
- **Filter Bar**: `.form .form-row` with inputs: status (select: all, active, past-due, canceled), plan (select: all, pro, team, enterprise), start date (date range), customer search (text)
- **Subscriptions Table**: `.table .table-compact` with 10 rows, columns: Customer, Plan, MRR, Start Date, End Date, Status, Next Billing Date, Actions
  - Sample row: `Acme Corp | Enterprise | $4,250.00 | 2023-06-15 | 2024-06-15 | Active | 2024-06-15 | [View] [Edit] [Cancel]`
  - Status badges: `.badge .badge-sm .status-text-*`
- **Quick Actions**: `.btn-group` with buttons: "Bulk Cancel", "Extend All", "Export CSV"
**Interactions**:
- Click "View" → navigates to `#/customers/{id}`
- Click "Edit" → navigates to `#/subscriptions/{id}/edit`
- Click "Cancel" → sets status to canceled and refreshes
- Filter change → updates table via client-side filter

---
### Invoices (`#/invoices`)
**Layout**: table + filter bar + pagination
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section .table-wrap`, `.form`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-outline`, `.table`, `.table-hover`, `.tr`, `.th`, `.td`
**Components**:
- **Filter Bar**: `.form .form-row` with inputs: status (select: all, paid, unpaid, refunded), date range (start/end), customer search (text), plan (select: all, pro, team, enterprise), sort (select: date new-old, amount high-low)
- **Invoices Table**: `.table .table-hover` with 10 rows, columns: Invoice #, Customer, Date, Plan, Amount, Status, PDF, Actions
  - Sample row: `INV-2024-0512 | Acme Corp | 2024-05-12 | Enterprise | $4,250.00 | Paid | [PDF] | [Refund]`
  - Status badges: `.badge .status-text-*`
  - Actions: `.btn .btn-xs .btn-outline` (PDF), `.btn .btn-xs .btn-danger` (Refund)
- **Pagination**: `.form .form-row` with page selector and items per page (10, 25, 50)
**Interactions**:
- Click "PDF" → opens invoice PDF preview modal
- Click "Refund" → sets status to refunded and refreshes
- Click customer name → navigates to `#/customers/{id}`
- Filter change → updates table via client-side filter

---
### Failed Payments (`#/failed-payments`)
**Layout**: table + filter bar + bulk actions
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section .table-wrap`, `.form`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`, `.table`, `.table-striped`, `.tr`, `.th`, `.td`
**Components**:
- **Filter Bar**: `.form .form-row` with inputs: status (select: all, pending, recovered, failed), date range, customer search, plan (select: all, pro, team, enterprise)
- **Failed Payments Table**: `.table .table-striped` with 10 rows, columns: Customer, Date, Invoice, Amount, Reason, Attempts, Status, Actions
  - Sample row: `Acme Corp | 2024-05-12 | INV-2024-0512 | $4,250.00 | Card declined | 2 | Pending | [Recover] [Mark Failed]`
  - Status badges: `.badge .badge-sm .status-text-*`
  - Actions: `.btn .btn-xs .btn-primary` (Recover), `.btn .btn-xs .btn-danger` (Mark Failed)
- **Bulk Actions**: `.form .form-row` with buttons: "Recover Selected", "Mark Failed Selected"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Recover" → initiates recovery flow (modal with options: retry card, update card, send invoice)
- Click "Mark Failed" → sets status to failed and refreshes
- Filter change → updates table via client-side filter
- Bulk select → enables bulk actions

---
### Plan Changes (`#/plan-changes`)
**Layout**: table + filter bar + actions
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section .table-wrap`, `.form`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-success`, `.table`, `.table-compact`, `.tr`, `.th`, `.td`
**Components**:
- **Filter Bar**: `.form .form-row` with inputs: status (select: all, pending, approved, rejected), date range, customer search, plan (select: all, pro, team, enterprise)
- **Plan Changes Table**: `.table .table-compact` with 10 rows, columns: Customer, Date, Current Plan, New Plan, MRR Change, Requested By, Status, Actions
  - Sample row: `Acme Corp | 2024-05-12 | Enterprise | Team | -$1,850.00 | Support | Pending | [Approve] [Reject]`
  - Status badges: `.badge .status-text-*`
  - Actions: `.btn .btn-xs .btn-success` (Approve), `.btn .btn-xs .btn-danger` (Reject)
- **Quick Actions**: `.btn-group` with buttons: "Approve Selected", "Reject Selected"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Approve" → updates plan and refreshes table
- Click "Reject" → marks as rejected and refreshes
- Filter change → updates table via client-side filter
- Bulk select → enables bulk actions

---
### Invoice Detail (`#/invoices/{id}`)
**Layout**: header + grid-2 + line items
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section`, `.card`, `.card-flat`, `.card-raised`, `.grid-2`, `.grid-4`, `.flex`, `.flex-col`, `.gap-*`
**Components**:
- **Header Card**: `.card .card-raised` with invoice number, customer name, date, status badge, total amount, due date, PDF download button
- **Metadata Grid**: `.grid-4 .card .card-flat` with fields: invoice date, due date, payment method, payment status, tax, discount, net amount
- **Line Items Table**: `.table .table-compact` with columns: Description, Quantity, Unit Price, Amount
  - Sample rows: "Enterprise Plan | 1 | $3,000.00 | $3,000.00", "Support Add-on | 1 | $250.00 | $250.00", "Tax | 1 | 8.875% | $284.38", "Total | | | $3,534.38"
- **Actions**: `.card .card-flat .flex .gap-*` with buttons: "Send Email", "Refund", "Void", "Download PDF"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Refund" → opens refund modal with amount and reason fields
- Click "Send Email" → triggers email with invoice PDF
- Click "Download PDF" → downloads invoice PDF

---
### Subscription Edit (`#/subscriptions/{id}/edit`)
**Layout**: form + actions
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section`, `.card`, `.card-raised`, `.form`, `.form-group`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`
**Components**:
- **Form**: `.card .card-raised .form` with fields:
  - Plan (select: pro, team, enterprise, custom)
  - Add-ons (multi-select: support, analytics, storage)
  - Billing cycle (select: monthly, annual)
  - Start date (date picker)
  - End date (date picker, optional)
  - Notes (textarea)
- **Actions**: `.form-actions .btn-group` with buttons: "Save", "Cancel", "Cancel Subscription"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Save" → updates subscription and navigates to subscriptions page
- Click "Cancel" → navigates back to subscriptions page
- Click "Cancel Subscription" → opens confirmation modal and sets status to canceled

---
### Customer Edit (`#/customers/{id}/edit`)
**Layout**: form + actions
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section`, `.card`, `.card-raised`, `.form`, `.form-group`, `.form-row`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`
**Components**:
- **Form**: `.card .card-raised .form` with fields:
  - Company name (text)
  - Status (select: active, suspended, canceled)
  - Plan (select: pro, team, enterprise, custom)
  - Billing email (email)
  - Support contact (email)
  - Notes (textarea)
- **Actions**: `.form-actions .btn-group` with buttons: "Save", "Cancel"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Save" → updates customer and navigates to customer detail page
- Click "Cancel" → navigates back to customer detail

---
### Plan Change Detail (`#/plan-changes/{id}`)
**Layout**: audit card + actions
**Template classes**: `.app .app-content .container .section`, `.card`, `.card-raised`, `.card-flat`, `.grid-2`
**Components**:
- **Audit Card**: `.card .card-raised` with change details: customer, date, current plan, new plan, MRR change, requested by, status, notes
- **Actions**: `.card .card-flat .btn-group` with buttons: "Approve", "Reject", "Request More Info"
**Interactions**:
- Click "Approve" → updates subscription plan and sets status to approved
- Click "Reject" → sets status to rejected and adds rejection reason
- Click "Request More Info" → opens modal for additional information

## State & Data Model
- **customers**: array of objects { id, name, domain, status, plan, mrr, nextBillingDate, contactEmail, supportContact, signupDate, logoUrl }
- **subscriptions**: array of objects { id, customerId, plan, mrr, startDate, endDate, status, nextBillingDate, addOns }
- **invoices**: array of objects { id, customerId, number, date, amount, status, pdfUrl, lineItems }
- **failedPayments**: array of objects { id, customerId, invoiceId, date, amount, reason, attempts, status, recoveryAction }
- **planChanges**: array of objects { id, customerId, date, currentPlan, newPlan, mrrChange, requestedBy, status, notes }

## Navigation Flows
- Dashboard → Failed Payments (`#/dashboard` → `#/failed-payments`)
- Dashboard → Plan Changes (`#/dashboard` → `#/plan-changes?status=pending`)
- Dashboard → Customers (`#/dashboard` → `#/customers`)
- Customers → Customer Detail (`#/customers` → `#/customers/{id}`)
- Customer Detail → Edit Customer (`#/customers/{id}` → `#/customers/{id}/edit`)
- Customer Detail → Subscriptions Tab (`#/customers/{id}` → `#/customers/{id}#subscriptions`)
- Customer Detail → Plan Changes Tab (`#/customers/{id}` → `#/customers/{id}#plan-changes`)
- Subscriptions → Subscription Edit (`#/subscriptions` → `#/subscriptions/{id}/edit`)
- Subscriptions → Customer Detail (`#/subscriptions` → `#/customers/{customerId}`)
- Invoices → Invoice Detail (`#/invoices` → `#/invoices/{id}`)
- Plan Changes → Plan Change Detail (`#/plan-changes` → `#/plan-changes/{id}`)

## Design Notes
- **Color scheme**: Dark theme with high-contrast UI elements. Status colors: active (green), suspended (amber), canceled (red), pending (blue), refunded (sky)
- **Typography**: Monospace for IDs/amounts, sans-serif for body. `.font-mono` for data tables and `.font-body` for text
- **Density**: Compact spacing (`.p-2`, `.gap-2`, `.m-1`), dense tables with minimal padding, small badges and buttons for high information density
- **Interactive elements**: Buttons are primary (blue), secondary (outline), danger (red). Status badges are small and positioned inline
- **Hover states**: Table rows highlight on hover (`.tr:hover .td`), buttons have subtle background change on hover
- **Responsive**: Sidebar collapses on narrow screens, tables scroll horizontally if needed, cards stack vertically on small screens

# Prototype Specification: OrderFlow Admin Console

## Template & Design System
- **Template**: Custom e-commerce admin console — dense table-first layout optimized for review and rapid data entry, with collapsible side panels for quick reference and modal dialogs for edits.
- **Design System**: E-Commerce Admin DS — high-density, functional, charcoal/green/white palette with compact spacing and high-contrast status badges.
- **CSS Class System**:
  - Layout: `.admin-shell`, `.topbar`, `.sidebar`, `.main-pane`, `.pane-30`, `.pane-70`, `.collapsible-panel`
  - Table: `.order-table`, `.table-wrap`, `.row-highlight`, `.cell-flagged`, `.cell-fraud`, `.cell-low-stock`
  - Cards: `.card`, `.card-flat`, `.card-header`, `.card-body`, `.status-badge` (with variants `.status-pending`, `.status-processing`, `.status-shipped`, `.status-refunded`, `.status-flagged`)
  - Forms: `.form-row`, `.form-group`, `.form-label`, `.form-input`, `.form-select`, `.form-button`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-sm`
  - Utility: `.flex-row`, `.flex-between`, `.grid-2`, `.grid-3`, `.badge`, `.tag`, `.flag`
- **Color Tokens**:
  - `--bg`: #1a1a1a
  - `--fg`: #e0e0e0
  - `--accent`: #28a745
  - `--surface`: #2d2d2d
  - `--border`: #444
  - `--muted`: #6c757d
  - `--font-display`: 'Inter', sans-serif
  - `--font-body`: 'Inter', sans-serif

## Overview
- **Product**: Internal order-management admin console for a mid-size online retailer.
- **Target audience**: Internal operations and customer-support staff.
- **Core purpose**: Centralized review, processing, and investigation of incoming orders, refunds/returns, inventory stock levels, and fraud-flagged orders.
- **Total pages**: 6 (Dashboard, Orders, Inventory, Flagged Orders, Refunds/Returns, Settings)

## Pages & Navigation
| Page ID | Route | Purpose | Layout Pattern | Entry Point |
|---------|-------|---------|----------------|-------------|
| dashboard | `#/dashboard` | Overview of today’s orders, stock alerts, and action items | hero-center + stat row + feature triplet | Yes |
| orders | `#/orders` | List and search all orders with filters and review actions | table-wrap + filter bar + pagination | Yes |
| inventory | `#/inventory` | Stock levels per SKU with low-stock alerts and bulk updates | table-wrap + sidebar panel | Yes |
| flagged | `#/flagged` | Orders flagged for review or suspected fraud | table-wrap + detail panel | Yes |
| refunds | `#/refunds` | Refunds and returns processing queue | table-wrap + modal forms | Yes |
| settings | `#/settings` | System settings and user roles | form layout + grid-2 | No |

## Page Specifications

### Dashboard (`#/dashboard`)
**Layout**: hero-center + stat row + feature triplet
**Template classes**: `.admin-shell .topbar .sidebar .main-pane .section.hero-center .stat-row .feature-triplet`
**Components**:
- **Hero center**: `.container .text-center`
  - Heading: "OrderFlow Admin Console"
  - Subheading: "Internal Ops Dashboard — Today"
  - Quick actions: 3 buttons `.btn-primary.btn-sm` (New Order Review, Bulk Refund, Adjust Stock)
- **Stat row**: `.section.stat-row .container .grid-3`
  - Card: `.card.card-flat` → "Orders Today" → 247 (order count)
  - Card: `.card.card-flat` → "Pending Refunds" → 12
  - Card: `.card.card-flat` → "Low Stock SKUs" → 8
- **Feature triplet**:
  - Left: `.card` → Recent flagged orders table `.order-table` (5 rows)
  - Center: `.card` → Today’s order volume chart (line chart, 24 points, labeled axes)
  - Right: `.card` → Top SKUs by sales `.table-wrap` (5 rows)

**Interactions**:
- Click "New Order Review" → navigates to `#/orders` with filter `status=pending`
- Click "Bulk Refund" → opens modal `.modal` with `.form-row` to select orders and reason
- Click "Adjust Stock" → navigates to `#/inventory`
- Click any row in recent flagged orders → navigates to `#/flagged` with `orderId={id}`

---

### Orders (`#/orders`)
**Layout**: table-wrap + filter bar + pagination
**Template classes**: `.admin-shell .topbar .sidebar .main-pane .section .table-wrap .filter-bar .pagination-bar`
**Components**:
- **Filter bar**: `.container .filter-bar .flex-row`
  - Input fields: `.form-input.form-sm` (Order ID, Customer Email, SKU)
  - Dropdowns: `.form-select.form-sm` (Status: All, Pending, Processed, Shipped, Refunded; Payment: All, Paid, Failed, Pending)
  - Buttons: `.btn.btn-sm` (Reset, Apply)
- **Order table**: `.order-table.table-wrap` (20 rows)
  - Columns: Order ID, Customer, SKU, Qty, Total, Status, Date, Actions
  - Data sample:
    - ORD-2025-05-471 | Jane Doe | SKU-90123 | 2 | $124.98 | Pending | 2025-05-12 14:22 | [Review] [Flag] [Actions ▼]
    - ORD-2025-05-468 | John Smith | SKU-89012 | 1 | $59.99 | Shipped | 2025-05-12 10:10 | [Refund] [View]
    - ORD-2025-05-465 | Alex Lee | SKU-78901 | 3 | $299.97 | Processing | 2025-05-12 09:01 | [Review] [Hold]
    - ORD-2025-05-462 | Priya Patel | SKU-67890 | 1 | $89.99 | Refunded | 2025-05-11 22:45 | [View]
    - ORD-2025-05-459 | Carlos Ruiz | SKU-56789 | 2 | $159.98 | Shipped | 2025-05-11 16:33 | [Refund]
- **Pagination**: `.pagination-bar .flex-between` → Page 1 of 25, 20 per page, Next/Prev

**Interactions**:
- Click [Review] on row → navigates to `#/orders/{id}` (detail view)
- Click [Flag] → sets `status=flagged`, highlights row `.cell-flagged`
- Click [Refund] → opens modal form for refund processing
- Change filter and click Apply → updates table live
- Click Order ID → navigates to `#/orders/{id}`

### Order Detail (`#/orders/{id}`)
**Layout**: hero-center + collapsible-panel + action strip
**Template classes**: `.admin-shell .topbar .sidebar .main-pane .section.hero-center .collapsible-panel .action-strip`
**Components**:
- **Hero center**: `.container .text-center`
  - Order ID: ORD-2025-05-471
  - Status badge: `.status-badge.status-pending` Pending
  - Customer: Jane Doe | jane@example.com | +1-555-123-4567
  - Shipping: 123 Main St, Anytown, CA 90210
  - Payment: Paid via Credit Card ending 4242 | $124.98 | 2025-05-12 14:22
- **Collapsible panel**: `.collapsible-panel .container .grid-2`
  - Left: Items (3)
    - SKU-90123 | Wireless Mouse | Qty 2 | $62.49 each
    - SKU-11223 | Mouse Pad | Qty 1 | $20.00
  - Right: Actions
    - Buttons: `.btn.btn-primary` Process Order, `.btn.btn-danger` Flag Order, `.btn` Hold Order, `.btn` Refund Order
- **Action strip**: `.action-strip .flex-between`
  - Chat with customer, Add note, Print packing slip
